card.name: Words just before a qualifying noun phrase
card.fires_on: Short linking words (that, for, the, a colon or opening bracket) right before a noun phrase that adds a qualifier or extra detail. Most often in the suicidality-monitoring warning, where it fires on 'need for' before 'close observation'.

modes.label: Need for close observation
modes.description: The word 'for' after 'advised of the need' in the antidepressant monitoring warning.
modes.example: Families and caregivers should be advised of the need<< for>> close observation and communication with the prescri

modes.label: Linking word in web text
modes.description: 'that' or 'the' that introduces a clause or a superlative description of a resource.
modes.example: Please note<< that>> collections may contain ARCHIVE resources, which

modes.label: Punctuation or label before details
modes.description: A colon, bracket or label word that opens an added detail or a qualifier.
modes.example: Pooled analyses of 199 placebo-controlled clinical trials<< (>>mono- and adjunctive therapy) of

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward qualifiers such as 'only' and 'additional'.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a qualifier or extra detail, such as 'need for' in the monitoring warning.
